title: Systemize what repeats
principle: When the same card/button/spacing appears thrice, extract tokens and components. Systems free attention for the non-repeating moments.
procedure: Extract tokens: space, type, color, radius.
Build components with clear variants—not one mega-prop soup.
Leave intentional one-offs outside the system with a note.
